trigger: cron job failures, cron errors, disabled cron jobs, cron orphans, last_status error, delivery failed
rule: When cron jobs fail: 1) After 3 consecutive failures of the same job, send one alert (not every tick). 2) Track disabled jobs with last_status=error — these are invisible orphans that used to work. 3) Surface on the mission card when >2 cron jobs are failing. 4) Never auto-restart a cron job that touches money without founder approval.
evidence: 2026-08-02: 4 cron jobs failing for 3+ hours (Summarize activity, config-auto-push, daily-strategist-audit, goal-of-the-moment). Watchdog detected them but no Telegram notification was sent.
